description: NaCN₃H₄S₂O₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of two NaCN₃H₄S₂O₂ sheets oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(1), np.int64(0)) direction. Na is bonded to two equivalent S and four O atoms to form distorted edge-sharing NaS₂O₄ octahedra. There is one shorter (3.05 Å) and one longer (3.15 Å) Na-S bond length. There are three shorter (2.43 Å) and one longer (2.45 Å) Na-O bond length. C is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one N and two S atoms. The C-N bond length is 1.35 Å. There is one shorter (1.70 Å) and one longer (1.73 Å) C-S bond length. There are three inequivalent N sites. In the first N site, N is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two N atoms. There is one shorter (1.30 Å) and one longer (1.33 Å) N-N bond length. In the second N site, N is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one N and one S atom. The N-S bond length is 1.68 Å. In the third N site, N is bonded in a distorted single-bond geometry to one C and one N atom. There are four inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. There are two inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded in an L-shaped geometry to one C and one N atom. In the second S site, S is bonded in a trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two equivalent Na and one C atom. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two H atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two H atoms.
